description: Oneiroi — Colore: Urban fog & silver Collezione: Wake Into The Dream Codice: 5922 Materiale: 100% Cotton Disegno: Classic Scala: Medium Altezza: 139 cm Rapporto: 32.5 cm × 33 cm Toni: Green ONEIROI, named for the Greek gods of dreams, is a 17th-century Persian motif whose hypnotic structure resists easy description. Its maze of concentric circles is dotted with five-petaled flowers and scrolling, horn-like ornament: a detail that carries deliberate ambiguity. As Homer wrote in The Odyssey, dreams that pass through a gate of horn are true; those that pass through a gate of ivory are false. ONEIROI offers no resolution — only the surface, layered with meaning and moving between states. Densely patterned and deeply referential, it rewards close inspection while functioning as an immersive field at distance. The medium repeat supports wall applications and statement upholstery where the arabesque complexity can fully unfold. Part of the WAKE INTO THE DREAM collection .
